svg.title: A0, A1 and A3 readings against body angle (sweep S2, 8 Nov 2026)
svg.desc: A0 is saturated at about 119,500 us from +2.0 to +8.4 degrees and falls about 6,000 us per degree on both sides. A1 rises and A3 falls as the body turns anticlockwise.
svg.text: A0 has a 6.4°-wide flat top with even slopes on both sides
Beacon 1 m in front · robot turned by hand on the table · sweep S2, 8 Nov 2026 · dots = single frames, line = mean per 0.5°
gyro angle (° , + = anticlockwise from above; 0 = start position)
